value.title: Crown Tri-Restoration Potion
value.description: Restore 9206 Health, 7582 Magicka, and 7582 Stamina immediately. Grants Major Fortitude, Major Intellect, and Major Endurance which increase your Health Recovery, Magicka Recovery, and Stamina Recovery by 30% for 36.3 seconds.

value.title: Gold Coast Spellcaster Elixir
value.description: Restore 7582 Magicka immediately. Grants Major Intellect which increases your Magicka Recovery by 30% for 36.3 seconds. Also grants Major Sorcery and Major Prophecy, increasing your Spell Damage by 20% and Spell Critical by 2629 for 36.3 seconds.

value.title: Gold Coast Swift Survivor Elixir
value.description: Restore 8536 Health immediately. Grants Major Fortitude and Major Expedition, increasing your Health Recovery by 30% for 36.3 seconds, and Movement Speed by 30% for 10.5 seconds. Also grants Unstoppable for 8 seconds, granting you immunity to knockback and disabling effects.

value.title: Gold Coast Warrior Elixir
value.description: Restore 7582 Stamina immediately. Grants Major Endurance which increases your Stamina Recovery by 30% for 36.3 seconds. Also grants Major Brutality and Major Savagery, increasing your Weapon Damage by 20% and Weapon Critical by 2629 for 36.3 seconds.
